land_pattern.notes: This datasheet's section 8 ('SOP-8 Package Outline Dimensions', p.8) is a MECHANICAL PACKAGE OUTLINE (lead/body envelope), not a dedicated recommended-land-pattern/stencil drawing - so pad_size_mm, row_spacing_mm and courtyard_excess_mm cannot be grounded from this PDF; pitch_mm=1.27 is the standard SOIC-8/SOP-8 pitch and falls within the datasheet's stated e = 1.24 (min) to 1.30 (max) mm range (not printed as a single BSC value here). Full outline table (mm, min-max): A -/1.75 (overall height), A1 0.05/0.20 (standoff), A2 1.30/1.50 (body height), A3 0.60/0.70 (foot height at heel), b 0.39/0.47 (lead width), c 0.20/0.24 (lead thickness), D 4.80/5.00 (body length, along pin row), E 5.80/6.20 (lead-tip-to-lead-tip span), E1 3.80/4.00 (body width), e 1.24/1.30 (pitch), h 0.30/0.50 (chamfer), L 0.50/0.80 (foot length), L1 1.00/1.10, theta 0-8deg. Use a standard IPC SOIC-8/1.27mm land-pattern generator for actual solder-pad geometry.
